title: Autoloader subsystem (static attributes)
description: Static attributes of an autoloader: the optional human preparation stage, the mechanical loading stage in seconds, its concurrency and the sounds of both stages. Stock and regeneration belong to the ammo rack model (regen_ammo_rack_static_attr.schema.json); ammo and crew discovery channels are per-instance fields, see dynamic/ammo_loader_dynamic_attr.schema.json.

$schema.description: Path of this JSON Schema, used for editor completion and validation.

basic_durability.description: Durability limit. Reaching zero only stops loading: the rack's stock is untouched and no cook-off happens. It recovers at 30% of the limit.

pass_damage.description: Whether damage is passed on to the subsystem host. First-party definitions write false: the loader absorbs hits itself.

limit_damage.description: Whether passed damage is limited to the remaining subsystem durability.

hidden.description: Whether the subsystem is hidden from the HUD.

reload_time.description: Base duration of the mechanical stage in seconds. Must be greater than 0: a zero-length stage counts as unconfigured, and an autoloader without a mechanical stage cannot express any loading path, so decoding rejects it.

human_reload_time.description: Base duration of the human preparation stage in seconds (standard crew). Omit or write 0 for a fully automatic flow; negative and non-finite values are decoding errors. The human stage runs before the mechanical one and its actual duration is multiplied by the post multiplier and the occupant's personal multiplier. A model that configures a human stage while no seat declares the loader's crew channel waits for an operator forever and logs a warning at startup.

can_supply_multiple.description: Concurrency. false = one job holds the only slot (exclusive, full speed); true = unlimited slots, each job at full speed. Stock is always shared through the upstream rack.

progress_sounds.description: Progress markers of the mechanical stage: keys are decimal strings '0.0'..'1.0', values the sound played at that progress. Threshold 0 is the stage start and 1 the stage completion; neither takes part in the crossing loop. A single advance that crosses several markers plays each of them in ascending order. Their sounds are positioned at the loader.

human_progress_sounds.description: Progress markers of the human preparation stage, keyed like progress_sounds. Their sounds are positioned at the launcher (the crew hands the round over at the breech), not at the loader. On a stage switch the remaining markers of the previous stage are played first, then the new stage starts.

fmod.description: Optional FMOD event reference for the mechanical stage. Playback wiring is not implemented yet.

sounds.description: Basic sounds plus the progress markers of both stages.
